title: a new table from a query

phases.job: Your team gave you a query, from_your_team/failed_runs.hql. Make it a table of your own, mart_dev.failed_runs, with the Toolbox: written, and checked against the query. Your Dev Database is mart_dev, and your Prod Database is team_prod. Each table's folder is /data/team/<its database>.db/<its name>, such as /data/team/mart_dev.db/weekly.
